delivery_methodology: The project will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process ensures that the solution evolves in alignment with client expectations and allows for timely adjustments.
Throughout the delivery cycle, quality is maintained through rigorous testing, code reviews, and integration practices. Scope changes are managed carefully to preserve project focus and timelines.

AI tools assist by drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts review, refine, and approve all outputs. This collaboration enhances productivity and accuracy, ensuring a high-quality deliverable that meets the client's requirements.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations, improve data accuracy, and enhance employee self-service capabilities. This initiative is critical to supporting the company's growth and ensuring efficient management of workforce information across branches.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key HR functions into a unified platform, delivered through a cloud-based microservices architecture. The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring timely delivery and continuous client collaboration. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a robust, scalable system that supports HR management, employee self-service, and seamless payroll integration.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates essential HR capabilities including employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and reporting dashboards. It empowers HR staff with tools for managing employee records, organisation structure, leave policies, and document expiry tracking, while providing employees with self-service access to personal data, leave applications, attendance corrections, and payslips.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational workflows by supporting multi-level approval processes, role-based access control, and automated notifications. The system's design facilitates efficient data exchange with the payroll system, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing. By automating routine HR tasks and enhancing data visibility, the solution addresses the client's goals of operational efficiency and improved workforce management.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-deployed microservices system utilizing a Java and Spring Boot backend, React frontend, and PostgreSQL database. This layered architecture separates presentation, business logic, and data storage, enabling scalability and maintainability.

Integration with external systems, such as the payroll system, is achieved through well-defined APIs and data exchange records. The system supports multiple environments for development, testing, and production, ensuring quality and reliability. Security is enforced through role-based access control, audit trails, and data encryption, meeting the client's requirements for data protection and compliance.

This architecture supports the performance and availability targets specified, including support for 300 concurrent users, fast page load times, and high system uptime, making it well-suited to the client's operational needs.
warranty_support: The warranty period covers defect correction and system support for a defined duration following project completion. During this time, any issues related to functionality or performance will be addressed promptly upon reporting.

Defects are tracked and managed through a formal process to ensure timely resolution. The warranty excludes enhancements or changes outside the agreed scope, which can be addressed through separate support agreements.

This approach provides Kalinaw Trading Corporation with confidence in system stability and access to expert assistance during the initial operational phase. Additional support and maintenance services are available as optional extensions beyond the warranty period.
